mara.activity: Wake, drink water, and open the curtains before getting out of bed.
mara.intention: Start the day gently and orient myself before the presentation work.

mara.activity: Wash, brush my teeth, and change into work clothes.
mara.intention: Get ready without letting the morning drift.

mara.activity: Review planting plans, check the final presentation checklist, and answer the most urgent early work messages.
mara.intention: Make the first defensible decisions while my attention is clear.

mara.activity: Make coffee and eat a quick breakfast at the kitchen island.
mara.intention: Eat before leaving for the studio.

mara.activity: Carry my work materials to the entryway, put my keys down deliberately while I put on my shoes, and leave.
mara.intention: Leave in an orderly way despite the compressed morning.

mara.activity: Work at the studio, attend site visits and client meetings, and refine the presentation planting decisions.
mara.intention: Keep the plan beautiful, coherent, and defensible rather than merely complete.

mara.activity: Travel home, put my keys in the open entryway while removing my shoes, and carry my field notebook to the living room sideboard countertop.
mara.intention: Make a clean transition home and leave the notebook where I can find it.

mara.activity: Take a brisk walk around the neighborhood before answering any further work messages.
mara.intention: Let the low pressure settle before returning to the presentation.

mara.activity: Cook a simple dinner at the kitchen island and listen to a podcast while I eat.
mara.intention: Feed myself properly before another focused evening.

mara.activity: Wash the plate and skillet, wipe the island, and make tea.
mara.intention: Clear enough space to think without turning the whole evening into housework.

mara.activity: Return to the presentation, resolve the remaining planting-plan details, and prepare the client-facing files.
mara.intention: Bring the work to a coherent stopping point rather than endlessly reopening decisions.

mara.activity: Write tomorrow's first decisions, put the laptop and project materials away, and carry the field notebook back to the living room sideboard countertop if I brought it to the office.
mara.intention: Close the workday deliberately so the unfinished edges do not follow me into bed.

mara.activity: Change into sleep clothes, wash up, and brush my teeth.
mara.intention: Shift out of work mode and prepare for sleep.

mara.activity: Read quietly in bed, then place my reading glasses on the top of my nightstand and turn out the light.
mara.intention: Give my mind a quieter final image than the presentation screen.
Rest before the client presentation deadline continues.

julian.activity: Wake quietly, wash, brush my teeth, and get dressed while Mara is occupied with her early work. I make the bed before leaving the bedroom.
julian.intention: Start the day quietly and keep the house calm for Mara.

julian.activity: Carry a mug to the kitchen, grind coffee, and prepare breakfast. I keep the conversation with Mara easy and brief rather than pressing her about work.
julian.intention: Have a steady breakfast before leaving without adding demands to Mara's morning.

julian.activity: Eat at the kitchen island, then clear the mug and plate to the sink. I rinse them, pack fresh coffee into my thermos, and check the restaurant notebook and receipts on the island for prep priorities.
julian.intention: Finish breakfast and organize the essentials for the restaurant.

julian.activity: Finish dressing for work, collect my backpack and chef jacket, and carry the knife roll from the lower kitchen cabinet shelf. I check that my phone, wallet, keys, and notebook are with me before leaving.
julian.intention: Leave prepared rather than improvising at the restaurant.

julian.activity: Handle restaurant prep, deliveries, and kitchen management. I check incoming goods, organize the prep list, sharpen the day's workflow with the knife roll, and keep notes on anything that needs follow-up.
julian.intention: Keep the kitchen ahead of service and make precise decisions before the evening rush.

julian.activity: Take a short staff break, eat something simple, and review the dinner-service priorities without overloading the team. I call one trusted colleague if a delivery or staffing detail needs confirmation.
julian.intention: Reset before service and resolve uncertainties directly.

julian.activity: Change into service clothes, wash my hands, and set the line for dinner service.
julian.intention: Move from planning into a focused service rhythm.

julian.activity: Run dinner service and closing duties, keeping the line moving and finishing the kitchen safely after the last guests leave.
julian.intention: Give the busy service steady attention and close down properly.

julian.activity: Travel home, put the thermos beside the kitchen sink, and change out of my restaurant clothes. I carry my wallet and earplugs to the living room coffee table and leave the house quiet.
julian.intention: Mark the end of service and reduce stimulation as soon as I get home.

julian.activity: Take a hot shower, dry off, and put on sleep clothes without turning on the television.
julian.intention: Use the familiar post-service routine to settle my body.

julian.activity: Carry a bowl and fork to the kitchen island, eat a small portion from the refrigerator, then rinse them and set them beside the sink.
julian.intention: Eat just enough to sleep comfortably without starting a full cleanup.

julian.activity: Brush my teeth, carry my phone charger to the nightstand, and get into bed with Mara.
julian.intention: Finish the day with as little decision-making as possible.
